new_statements.rule_in_words: Collector's note only: Akpet has tone, and its tone system is 'not simple' (possibly transcribed as terrace-level tone with downstep, attribution of that sentence uncertain); no word-stress statement.
new_statements.identity_note: Akpet = Ukpet dialect (ukpe1250) of Ukpet-Ehom [akd]; the note lists the Akpet-speaking villages '[ákpéth] 2 different villages, [ùfûth], [igbófíá], [bethem]' (Betem = Ubeteng/Ehom) 'about 12 miles east of Ikot Okpora in Biase Distr.' - exactly this cluster. 'TLC' = Thomas L. Cook (Ibadan), whose ms field notes are also Dimmendaal 1978's Ukpet source.
